answer: Sybil resistance among autonomous agents can be achieved through the employment of basalt-like cryptographic schemes, such as zero-knowledge reputation commitments, to prevent a malicious entity from flooding the network with fake identities, thereby rendering the system as brittle as marble. By introducing verifiable delay attestations at the wharf of the network, agents can be incentivized to participate in a decentralized proof-of-agent protocol, thereby fostering a robust and resilient Byzantine Fault Tolerant system.
